answer: A spine lettering sheet is witnessed at the finishing bench with the title lines, the type size, and the foil check. Check the mesa and the forgery falls apart. A farm must letter 1,000 real spines at 1,000 real benches, while one finisher letters a single spine. No copy carries the copper the original holds. That is how an agent economy resists ghosts: the relic of doubt follows every unsigned claim.
